node.title: Re^3: How to parse not closed HTML tags that don't have any attributes?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
no matter what I do, the
element in it always gets removed, so it seems to me that I cannot search inside the address string.

I can't reproduce this (see the output in the [[]]s below), and you haven't said what your expected output is or what you mean by "search inside the address string" - see [id://174051] and [id://1177642]. As an example, I can replace the
like so:

use warnings; use strict; use Mojo::DOM; use Mojo::Util qw/trim/; my $dom = Mojo::DOM->new(<<'HTML');
Sample Street 123
45678 Randomcity
HTML my $addr = $dom->find('.address address')->first; print "[[$addr]]\n"; $addr->find('br')->map('replace',"\n"); print "[", trim($addr->text), "]\n"; __END__ [[
Sample Street 123
45678 Randomcity
]] [Sample Street 123 45678 Randomcity]

Edit: Forgot to remove the "(updated)" from the node's title before it got a reply. At the time of writing this node and its reply were not actually updated.
